summary: Completed testing of Google OAuth Search Console implementation. All OAuth endpoints validated successfully. Backend OAuth client is properly configured with web credentials and callback URIs for preview + production domains. OAuth flow works correctly without exposing secrets. Frontend sanity check passed with no regression.
passed_tests: GET /api/seo/search-console/oauth/status - Returns OAuth client readiness with web client type, preview + 3 production callback URIs, not_connected status (acceptable)
GET /api/seo/search-console/oauth/start - Returns 302 redirect to Google OAuth with correct client_id, response_type=code, scope=webmasters, preview callback redirect_uri, and state parameter
GET /api/seo/search-console/status - Includes nested oauth status information alongside service-account status
POST /api/seo/search-console/oauth/submit - Gracefully handles not_connected state with message 'Connexion OAuth Google Search Console requise.' without crashing
Frontend sanity check - App loads successfully with navigation and main content visible, no JavaScript errors blocking functionality
